title: ashwingopalsamy/euro-area-deposit-facility-rate-dataset / daily
description: The rate in force on every calendar day, from 1 Jan 2000 (or the first point of the series, if later) to the date the official series was last observed. Ready to join to any daily or monthly data.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the jurisdiction (EA for the euro area).

level_kind.description: `point` for a single rate, `range` for a target range (the US since 16 Dec 2008).

rate_pct.description: The rate in percent: the point, or the upper bound of a range. Never a midpoint.

rate_bps.description: The same rate as an exact integer number of basis points.

rate_low_pct.description: Lower bound of a range in percent; equals `rate_pct` for a point rate.

rate_high_pct.description: Upper bound of a range in percent; equals `rate_pct`.

era_id.description: The period of one rate basis this row belongs to; joins to `eras`.

era_basis.description: `policy` for the policy rate itself, `observation` for an earlier proxy rate kept for history.

is_change.description: True on the day a new rate took effect.
